quote: Every driver of a vehicle approaching a stop intersection indicated by a stop sign shall stop before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection or, if there is no crosswalk, shall stop at a clearly marked stop line, or if none, then at the point nearest the intersecting highway where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the intersecting highway before entering the intersection.

activation.condition: driver approaches an intersection indicated by a stop sign governing that approach

obligation.description: stop before the near-side crosswalk; if none, at a clearly marked stop line; if neither, at the nearest point with a view of approaching intersecting-highway traffic, before entering the intersection

timing.description: original full halt precedes body crossing of the selected reference and entering the intersection

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: stop intersection indicated by a stop sign
judgment_calls_needed.note: Official status and governance cannot be inferred from a synthetic sign or map label.
Original marking source and visible placement require review when no crosswalk exists.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: has a view of approaching traffic
judgment_calls_needed.note: The first view of approaching intersecting-highway traffic is a source-dependent observation, not a fixed distance.

parameter_refs.name: full_halt_location
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: authored before-reference or inside-crosswalk controller policy

parameter_refs.name: commanded_approach_speed
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: positive engineering m/s, not a legal cutoff
